parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit passes. It is one file, src/application/task-service.ts, that serves a single concern: application use cases for task management. TaskService creates users, projects and tasks, lists tasks and marks a task done. The user and project methods are thin and support task assignment and ownership, so they do not form a separate concern. The service works only through the injected domain repository interfaces (UserRepository, ProjectRepository, TaskRepository) and raises domain errors, so it does not go around its own abstractions. Each validation rule lives in one private helper: requireText, requireProject, requireUser, parseDueDate and isTaskStatus. createTask and listTasks both call isTaskStatus instead of repeating the check. There are two minor issues, neither serious enough to fail the unit: (1) the status error message "status must be todo, in progress, or done" is written out twice; (2) isTaskStatus hard-codes the TaskStatus values, which probably belong in the domain next to the TaskStatus type. I can't see the domain files, so I can't confirm the domain already has its own check that this one duplicates.
